مَثْلُوجٌ : fem. with ة: the latter applied to land (أَرْض), meaning Snowed upon. (S, A, Msb.) ―
-b2- Water cooled, or made cold, with snow. (TA.) A poet says, speaking of a woman's mouth, “يُخَالُ مَثْلُوجًا وَإِن لَمْ يُثْلَجِ
” [It would be thought to be cooled with snow, though it was not cooled therewith]. (TA.) ―
-b3- مَثْلُوجُ الفُؤَادِ (tropical:) A man (S) stupid, dull, or wanting in intelligence. (S, A, Msb, K.) [See also ثُلُجٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
